Rights labels are decided by the release gate's per-recipe verdict (validate_corpus recipe_rights_errors), not by source_type: every rights-cleared FL original/original-rewrite ships 'original' (762 of 762); validate_bundle re-runs the gate and refuses any 'original' it does not clear.
